# MAVI — Tailor Your Design

> Egyptian made-to-measure modest fashion and custom dressmaking atelier based in Cairo/Giza and delivering across Egypt. Founded in 2020 with 1,000+ customers served.

## Brand Summary
- **Official Brand Name:** MAVI (never spelled in Arabic transliteration — always `MAVI`)
- **Tagline:** Tailor Your Design
- **Country & Currency:** Egypt (`EGP`)
- **Languages:** Arabic (`ar`, RTL primary) and English (`en`, LTR toggle)
- **Specialization:** Made-to-measure dresses, skirts, blouses, abayas, and bespoke custom designs sewn from customer photos or catalogue styles using customer body measurements.

## Public Pages
- [MAVI Storefront & Catalogue](https://9ev8jkxh7wzb-production-hkkaenim.us-central1.suga.run/store/): Interactive bilingual storefront featuring seasonal collections (`Summer`, `Winter`, `New Collection`, `Offers`), product search, customer reviews, brand story, and custom design upload.
- [Custom Design Service](https://9ev8jkxh7wzb-production-hkkaenim.us-central1.suga.run/store/custom-design): Step-by-step guide to submitting inspiration photos, choosing fabric/colour (MAVI fabric or customer's own fabric), and entering body measurements.
- [Repairs & Refunds Policy](https://9ev8jkxh7wzb-production-hkkaenim.us-central1.suga.run/store/returns): Clear Arabic and English policy explaining craftsmanship guarantees, repairs, and refunds.
- [Dynamic Product Pages](https://9ev8jkxh7wzb-production-hkkaenim.us-central1.suga.run/store/product/): Dedicated indexable URLs for every active made-to-measure style listed in the XML Sitemap.
- [XML Sitemap](https://9ev8jkxh7wzb-production-hkkaenim.us-central1.suga.run/sitemap.xml): Live database-backed sitemap of all active storefront styles and public pages.

## Measurements & Ordering Process
1. **Saved Measurements (in cm):** Customers save their measurements once in their account (`بياناتي` / My Account):
   - Core tailoring measurements (required): Bust (`دوران الصدر`), Waist (`دوران الوسط`), Hip (`دوران الهيب`), and Desired length (`الطول المطلوب`).
   - Recommended & optional measurements: Shoulder width (`عرض الكتف`), Sleeve length (`طول الكم`), and Arm circumference (`دوران الذراع`).
   - A 2-minute Arabic measurement video guide is embedded directly inside the storefront and on the custom design page.
2. **Order Submission & Review:** Customers select a catalogue style (with fabric and colour choices) or upload up to 10 custom design inspiration photos.
3. **Shipping & Deposit Confirmation:** Our team reviews the request, confirms the governorate delivery fee, and issues a deposit quote (percentage or fixed amount depending on the order). Reservations and tailoring begin after deposit receipt review via InstaPay or mobile wallet (e.g., Vodafone Cash).
4. **Tailoring Lead Time:** Typically 5–14 business days depending on the selected style and handwork details, followed by nationwide delivery across Egypt or agreed pickup.

## Repairs, Alterations & Refunds Policy
- **MAVI Craftsmanship Errors:** If an issue is MAVI's responsibility and can be repaired, MAVI covers pickup shipping, repair, and return delivery in full. If it cannot be repaired, MAVI issues an immediate refund.
- **Customer Selection Issues:** If an issue arises from customer measurements or design choices, MAVI assists with alterations/repairs at the customer's expense.
- **Exchanges:** Made-to-measure custom pieces are not exchanged, without affecting statutory consumer rights under applicable law.
